name: Jia Li
headline: Senior Data Engineer
status: Open to senior data engineering roles
intro: Data engineer with 10+ years building large-scale ETL/ELT pipelines and data platforms. At Alibaba I own the data infrastructure behind Taobao Flash Sale — 10M+ orders and tens of billions of events a day — from high-throughput ETL to the data-quality monitoring other teams rely on.
bio: I'm a data engineer with 10+ years building large-scale ETL/ELT pipelines, data platforms, and the analytics and ML infrastructure that sits downstream of them. At Alibaba I own the backend data pipelines for Taobao Flash Sale, an instant-commerce product processing 10M+ orders a day: high-throughput distributed ETL that turns tens of billions of raw events into analytics-ready tables, plus the automated data-quality and drift monitoring other teams depend on. I move comfortably between core pipeline engineering and the analytics layer built on top of it (metric design, statistical anomaly detection, experimentation infrastructure, and production ML integration), and I've led and mentored engineering teams of 5–17.

roles.title: Senior Data R&D Expert
roles.summary: Own backend ETL/ELT and data platform infrastructure for an instant-commerce product processing 10M+ orders/day — pipelines, APIs, and shared data assets consumed by product, BI, algorithm, and data science teams.

highlights.title: High-throughput ETL
highlights.text: Engineered MaxCompute pipelines with custom stateful UDAFs executing in cluster memory, eliminating SQL GROUP BY shuffle overhead on high-volume aggregations — cutting both runtime and compute cost at hyperscale.

highlights.title: Data reliability & observability
highlights.text: Built automated data-quality and drift monitoring covering SLA freshness, completeness, cross-source reconciliation, and rolling-window statistical drift detection, feeding production diagnostic dashboards used by on-call engineers.

highlights.title: Automated anomaly diagnosis
highlights.text: Built an autonomous pipeline (anomaly detection → dynamic multi-dimensional query assembly → statistical analysis → owner routing) that diagnoses business-metric anomalies end to end and routes them to the responsible team with evidence attached.

highlights.title: Natural-language data access (NL2SQL)
highlights.text: Designed a semantic-block NL2SQL framework that lets non-technical users query complex business data in plain language: validated, human-authored SQL blocks hold the tricky logic and the LLM only composes them — substantially more accurate than free-form text-to-SQL.

highlights.title: Platform services for downstream teams
highlights.text: Designed data contracts and APIs consumed by product, BI, and algorithm teams — the platform layer other engineering teams build on.

highlights.title: ML infrastructure integration
highlights.text: Deployed PyTorch multi-modal embedding pipelines into production recommendation infrastructure, handling batch inference at scale.

highlights.title: Experimentation
highlights.text: Analyzed ~1B behavioral records to find where extra merchant impressions stopped converting, then validated an exposure-frequency cap with a controlled A/B test; it became standard platform policy.

roles.title: Data R&D Expert
roles.summary: Shared data platform serving four independent business units: Tmall Supermarket, Taoxiandao, Alibaba International, and Digital Agriculture.

highlights.title: Multi-tenant ETL platform
highlights.text: Built shared data-ingest infrastructure spanning four business units with different source systems — conformed-dimension modeling instead of a forked pipeline per tenant, serving a 60+ indicator reporting framework.

highlights.title: Log-to-table pipeline at scale
highlights.text: Processed tens of billions of raw behavior-log records into structured, analytics-ready tables via regex/multi-condition parsing and cycle-removal path reconstruction; adopted as shared infrastructure by downstream analytics teams.

roles.title: Data Product Expert
roles.summary: Real-time data products for Alibaba's online-to-offline grocery chain during its rapid expansion.

highlights.title: Real-time data ingest
highlights.text: Formed and led a 5-engineer team building real-time ETL/data-ingest infrastructure and internal APIs supporting network growth from 90 to 300 stores.

highlights.title: Inventory forecasting
highlights.text: Designed a predictive inventory-forecasting pipeline operated by frontline logistics teams, supporting a single campaign that cleared 100M+ units without infrastructure incident.

roles.title: Product R&D Manager
roles.summary: Smart-logistics systems for JD's unmanned-retail stores.

highlights.title: RFID identification pipelines
highlights.text: Led and mentored a 6-engineer cross-functional team building RFID-based automated identification pipelines and dynamic replenishment infrastructure for unmanned retail.

roles.title: WMS R&D Manager
roles.summary: Backend and warehouse-management platform for Asia No.1, then Asia's largest automated fulfillment facility.

highlights.title: Record peak, zero downtime
highlights.text: Led a 17-engineer team building the WMS backend; on-site technical command lead during Double 11 2015 — 502,000 outbound orders in 24 hours with zero downtime, a single-warehouse world record at the time.

highlights.title: Scientific Warehouse Layout
highlights.text: Initiated a data-mining project on product co-occurrence to optimize picking paths; awarded the JD Gold Project First Prize and published as a technical paper.

highlights.title: Structured log ETL
highlights.text: Built regex-based log-parsing ETL converting raw operational log streams into analytics-ready tables, adopted as shared infrastructure by BI and analytics teams.

roles.title: Senior Software Engineer → R&D Team Lead
roles.summary: Enterprise telecom systems for China Mobile (Beijing) and PCCW (Hong Kong).

highlights.title: OSS/BSS backends
highlights.text: Built enterprise OSS/BSS backend systems in Java for China Mobile (Beijing) and PCCW (Hong Kong), including five years on-site in Hong Kong in a fully English-speaking environment.

highlights.title: Network optimization
highlights.text: Led development of telecom network-optimization products on-site at China Mobile Beijing, earning multiple client commendation letters.
